metrics.label: Platform monthly recurring revenue
metrics.formula_language: normative pseudocode; not executed SQL or a runtime reader

formula.expression: ROUND_ONCE_TO_CURRENCY_MINOR(SUM(net_recurring_interval_amount_minor / interval_months)) at as_of
formula.calculation_evidence: Retain each integer numerator and denominator and aggregate exact rational values before one display rounding.
formula.policy_status: Defined for preparation; Finance/Product acceptance and actual Stripe settings comparison required under D10.
formula.status_rules: Include active and past_due supported items; disclose past_due subtotal. Exclude trialed items, trialing subscriptions, canceled, unpaid, incomplete, incomplete_expired and paused. An active pause_collection arrangement is an explicit exception until its effective contract treatment is reviewed.
formula.discount_rules: Deduct effective recurring permanent/repeating discounts; ignore one-time invoice coupons in contract MRR. Provider-compatible stacking/order and fixed-discount allocation must be supported or item is an exception.
formula.proration_rules: Do not sum invoice prorations. Use currently effective recurring item quantity/price at cutoff; pending changes do not apply until accepted effective time.
formula.cancellation_rules: Scheduled end-of-period cancellation remains until contract actually ends; request timestamp is not effective termination.
formula.supported_prices: Verified platform-only licensed per-unit monthly/annual items with positive integer interval_count and quantity, exact known currency units and effective price/discount state. Metered, tiered, transformed-quantity, mixed/ambiguous or missing-history items remain exceptions.

metrics.label: Source freshness and export coverage
metrics.formula_language: normative pseudocode; not executed SQL or a runtime reader

formula.expression: lag_seconds=check_clock-source_cutoff_at when both known and nonfuture; expected-vs-observed canonical records produce coverage only when expected inventory is independently known. Report last_success_at, current run status and configuration version.
formula.coverage_rule: For matched keys, coverage=matched_expected_records/expected_record_count; duplicates or extra rows never raise coverage. expected0 yields empty population, not100% by convention.
formula.freshness_rule: A recent ingestion or query timestamp cannot make an old source cutoff fresh. Required-source card freshness uses the weakest required source.

metrics.label: Outcome linkage completeness and pending maturity
metrics.formula_language: normative pseudocode; not executed SQL or a runtime reader

formula.expression: For the fixed eligible cohort, report separate counts for immature/pending, mature with complete required stage evidence, mature with a missing expected link, mature with confirmed no outcome, and source-unknown. For each stage link check, completeness=verified_expected_links/expected_links only when expected_links is known.
formula.noninference: No completed job after a fully observed mature window is an observed no-outcome, not necessarily a missing link. A verified booked/completed/collected source object with a broken expected relationship is a link exception.
formula.money_rule: Unallocated financial residual from M14 is shown separately by currency; never convert missing link count into assumed lost revenue.

metrics.population: All M10 eligible opportunities, including unselected/declined/failed and pending; expected links follow accepted stage applicability rather than presumed success.
